title: COGNITIVE MODELS CAN REVEAL INTERPRETABLE VALUE TRADE-OFFS IN LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating how language models navigate trade-offs between competing human values, such as truthfulness (informational utility) and politeness (social utility). It uses a cognitive model framework to analyze 'value alignment,' 'sycophancy,' and ethical communication dilemmas, which are core components of moral and ethical reasoning in AI.
